_doc: Survivor job flags; skill_pool, starting_skill and mobility_skill live in jobs/<line>.json (tier C: ADR 0006).
_default_job: tier C: spec #296 (H2 #298): the job of a fresh character and of every tool run or test that names none (JobTree.default_job). Pinned so that a second playable job never changes it; Hero is always chosen explicitly (--job=112, the creation Job page). The owner can flip it with this one line.
